data.gender_notes: Juwariah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'jarara', meaning 'to be gentle'. In Islamic tradition, Juwariah is considered to be a noble and beautiful name for a girl. The name Juwariah carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Juwariah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Juwariah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
